title: Oral Surgery
subtitle: Dr Sami & Dr Mina Count on You
synopsis:
Welcome to the Oral Surgery specialty.

Dr Sami Kikou and Dr Mina Lilou are two passionate surgeons. One is fast and instinctive, the other is precise and methodical. Their complementarity is the strength of their practice.

Between simple and complex extractions, dry sockets, sinus communications and precision procedures… each intervention is a challenge.

A diagnostic error, a poor technique, and patient safety is compromised.

The precision of gestures, patient safety, and the practice's reputation rest on YOUR shoulders.

chapters.debutant1: The Foundations of Surgery - Dr Sami Kikou and Dr Mina Lilou receive their first patient of the day. Between simple extractions and complications, they debate best practices. Their complicity is the strength of the practice.
chapters.debutant2: Mastering Techniques - Dr Sami and Dr Mina deepen their practice. They discover flap techniques, sutures and the management of postoperative complications.
chapters.intermediaire1: Complex Interventions - Dr Sami and Dr Mina face difficult cases: impacted teeth, hooked roots, sinus communications. Their expertise is put to the test.
chapters.intermediaire2: Complication Management - Dr Sami and Dr Mina manage emergencies: hemorrhages, infections, dry sockets. Their composure and competence save situations.
chapters.expert1: Advanced Surgery - Dr Sami and Dr Mina become references in surgery. They innovate and train young surgeons in cutting-edge techniques.
chapters.expert2: Excellence and Transmission - After years of practice, Dr Sami and Dr Mina pass on their knowledge to the new generation. Their legacy is a surgical art in service to the patient.

chapterEndings.debutant1: Dr Sami and Dr Mina have laid the foundations of their surgical practice. But the journey is still long...
chapterEndings.debutant2: Techniques are mastered. Dr Sami and Dr Mina are ready for complex cases.
chapterEndings.intermediaire1: Complex interventions are successful. Dr Sami and Dr Mina gain confidence.
chapterEndings.intermediaire2: Complications are successfully managed. Dr Sami and Dr Mina are experts.
chapterEndings.expert1: Innovation is here. Dr Sami and Dr Mina train young surgeons.
chapterEndings.expert2: Dr Sami and Dr Mina have accomplished their mission. Surgery has become an art in service to the patient.
